BiblicalUsage: Naqiq is a cleft or a hole in the rock, and it is used for hiding places and for the enemy's rest. In Isaiah 7:19 they shall come and rest in the desolate valleys and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns and upon all bushes, and in Jeremiah 13:4 the Lord tells Jeremiah to hide the girdle in a hole of the rock by the Euphrates.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a hole in the rock can be a hiding place or a grave, depending on who sends you there; Jeremiah hides a girdle and finds it ruined, and the enemy rests in the holes of a desolate land.
